hypothesis.statement: The variance risk premium (VRP = implied minus trailing realized volatility) is the canonical options edge. A rich premium (top trailing tercile of DVOL/100 - RV30) prices fear/insurance demand and tends to precede positive forward BTC spot returns; a cheap premium (bottom tercile) reflects complacency. The signal is contrarian on the premium: long spot when VRP is rich, short when cheap, flat in the middle tercile.
hypothesis.expected_sign: positive mean spot return in the signal direction net of 15bps
hypothesis.mechanism_detail: DVOL is Deribit's 30-day forward implied-vol index; RV30 is trailing 30-day realized vol (annualised). Their spread is the variance risk premium. Sellers of options demand a premium for bearing variance risk; the premium widens with fear and compresses with complacency. Empirically the premium is a contrarian forward-return signal in equity and crypto vol markets. Here it is harvested as a DIRECTIONAL SPOT-timing signal conditioned on the premium tercile.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The trailing tercile rank of (DVOL/100 - RV30) has no predictive power for forward BTC spot returns.
hypothesis.known_caveats_at_registration: P&L SEMANTICS: this is a directional spot-timing signal conditioned on VRP, NOT a short-straddle/short-vol position; forward return is measured on spot (consistent with the in-sample HV-2 battery). EDGE INELIGIBLE on the disciplined basis: the lockbox-train-slice canonical Sharpe is 0.265 < 0.30 (candidate.edge floor). It would pass the full Edge gate on the full sample (Sharpe 0.329), but that computation spends the sealed lockbox, so it is NOT used. Registered as a FEATURE candidate. IS DSR (0.165) and BH-p (0.289) fail the Validated gate in-sample — expected; the Validated gate is evaluated on forward returns.
hypothesis.role_note: Feature role: passes candidate.feature gate on the lockbox-train slice (sensitivity 100%, OOS Sharpe +0.50 > 0, WF 60%, clone_r 0.37 < 0.90). Independent of the existing spot cluster (max corr 0.37 vs vol/funding features) and orthogonal to spot (options vol-surface axis). Primary value: ML-conditioning feature on the variance-risk-premium axis.

function_spec.name: VRP Spread (HV-2)
function_spec.data_source: Deribit DVOL daily index + Binance BTCUSDT spot RV30 (1m OHLCV resampled to daily close)
function_spec.entry_condition_long: VRP spread in top trailing tercile (rolling RW=252, min_periods=126): vrp > q(1 - pctile/100)
function_spec.entry_condition_short: VRP spread in bottom trailing tercile: vrp < q(pctile/100)
function_spec.flat_condition: middle tercile, OR NaN inputs (rv30/dvol/quantile warmup), OR insufficient history (< MIN_HISTORY)
function_spec.hold_days_note: IS / DVOL-family battery used hold_days=1 (continuous daily re-evaluation). Forward collection uses hold_days=7 to reduce turnover. IS and forward Sharpe/DSR are NOT directly comparable; the Validated gate evaluates forward returns only.
function_spec.exit_rule: scheduled exit at entry + 7 calendar days; signal re-evaluated at exit for re-entry; no intra-hold exits
function_spec.trade_counting_definition: each 7-day evaluation window is one trade; sequential and non-overlapping
function_spec.sensitivity_note: All 3 variants positive (sign-stable) on BOTH the full sample and the lockbox-train slice -> sens_pass_frac = 1.000 (>= 0.60 gate).
function_spec.governance_phase: Phase F forward evidence collection (feature candidate)
function_spec.lockbox_status: SEALED — 2025-06-01..2026-05-31 held out; not spent for gating

observation_floors.rationale: Feature-role, low per-trade Sharpe; n=30 forward trades at hold_days=7 (~52/yr max) is ~7-12 months. 12 months minimum before assessment to span vol regimes. Both rich-premium (long) and cheap-premium (short) trades must be observed.

content: DSR on non-overlapping 7-day forward trade returns (compute when n >= 30)

The DSR minimum n >= 30 is a governance criterion DISTINCT from the observation floor minimum_trades = 30. The two coincide numerically for this family and are NOT conflated: the observation floor governs admissibility, the DSR minimum governs when DSR/BH may be computed. FR-5's three minima remain separate, and n >= 5 stays the mathematical computability guard which never establishes sufficiency. Adopted at FB-10b-O (FDB-8 Option A, human-authorized).

source_divergence_assessment.data_source: Deribit DVOL (single implied-vol source) + Binance spot
source_divergence_assessment.conclusion: DVOL is a single-source index; RV30 is from Binance spot. The tercile-rank construction is robust to small cross-source level differences. Spot close is stable across exchanges (<0.1% spread).
